04cbc2629f.9: Every decimal palindrome whose first three digits are 739 has maximum ancestry depth `H(P) <= 39`. Together with the absence of palindromes at steps 0–39 from 196, this excludes that family from its orbit at every time. The uniform bounds for 217, 218, 620, and 777 also tighten to 23, 34, 12, and 25 respectively. The three-digit prefix catalogue grows from 396 classes to 397; this is not a completion percentage for the full conjecture.

Cross-checks cover every short-source boundary, seven/eight-digit raw sum words, long words with fixed random seeds, and small-integer height calculations. See the [proof](../contributions/2026-10-15-seven-column-prefix/P196_739_Proof.md) and [verification records](../contributions/2026-10-15-seven-column-prefix/verification_results.json) for the precise scope and results. 3f444ed9b7.10: if the tree lookup assigns rank `r` to the endpoint projection, the actual number of steps is at most `r`.

3f444ed9b7.15: `short_target_unique` and `target_project_mem_initialWords` show that every projection of the target's last predecessor belongs to a finite family:
3f444ed9b7.16: the complete six-column word `[7,3,9,9,3,7]`, together with all 10000 words `[7,3,9,a,b,c,d]`, whose four free digits range over 0–9.

3f444ed9b7.21: `no_196_739_palindrome_of_finite_checks` combines this with the kernel-checked absence of palindromes at times 0–100 to exclude 739 palindromes from the ordinary 196 orbit at every time.

3f444ed9b7.25: 1. `CheckedRows tree (longPred 7)`: every tree row checks the complete executable inverse enumeration.
3f444ed9b7.26: 2. `∀ s ∈ shortWords, lookup tree (nextWord s) = none`: the actual images of all admissible short sources lie outside the tree.

2544ecc0dd.1: # Verification of the actual whole-word to long-prefix connection
2544ecc0dd.5: The main source is `ActualPrefix.lean` in the parent directory, namespace `SevenColumnProjection`.
2544ecc0dd.9: - `actual_forwardPrefix`: for any `Admissible L q` and `k ≤ L`, running the pure-List deterministic `forwardPrefix` with the unique actual inner high carry `DecimalDigits.carry q (L-k)` gives exactly the length-k prefix of `nextColumns q L`.
2544ecc0dd.10: - `actual_forward_admitted`: that actual carry belongs to `{0,1}`, so enumeration of both high inner carries includes the actual output.
2544ecc0dd.11: - `actual_longCompatible`: with `0 < k` as well, the actual prefix satisfies the columnwise inverse relation in `PrefixInverse.lean`.
2544ecc0dd.12: - `actual_mem_prefixPredecessors`: the actual source prefix belongs to the executable inverse enumeration of the target prefix; coverage of actual transitions is not assumed as an extra premise.
2544ecc0dd.13: - `wordPrefix_eq_range_map`: the recursive List prefix equals `(List.range k).map q`, allowing direct composition with the short-source module.
2544ecc0dd.15: All conclusions require only `k ≤ L`, including overlapping end prefixes and `k=L`. In the latter case the actual high inner carry is zero. Seven columns is the specialization `k=7`. Both low-end and high-end carries are computed from the same complete actual word `q`, not assumed independent.
2544ecc0dd.17: `forwardPrefix` corresponds entry by entry to one carry branch of `verify_certificates.py:forward_prefixes`: propagate low-end carries in forward order, then high-end carries in reverse order. Without overflow, add corresponding entries. With overflow, prepend 1 to the high-end digit sequence, then truncate and add to the low-end sequence's length. `highDigits_segment` establishes simultaneous equalities for the actual carries and digits of that reverse-order computation.
